screenshots.role: Giants Stadium / Night / Clear diagnostic-route selection

manual_capture_plan.camera_protocol: For both s42 captures, enter instant replay on the same play state, hold left stick down for 4.00 seconds, tap D-pad Up 15 times with 0.05-second gaps, then tap Xbox B 30 times with 0.04-second gaps. Continue only until the complete suspended top-center board is in frame.
capture_sequence: Launch xemu-retail-wide-overlay8.toml, confirm the retail-XBE candidate reaches the title or main menu, save retail-wide-overlay8-main-menu.png, then close xemu cleanly.

Launch xemu-s42-control.toml with the prepared state, select Giants Stadium / Night / Clear, save s42-control-target-selection.png, follow the camera protocol, save s42-control-board-frame.png, then close xemu cleanly.

Launch xemu-s42-wide-overlay8.toml with the same selection, teams, play state, replay entry, and camera protocol; save s42-wide-overlay8-target-selection.png and s42-wide-overlay8-board-frame.png, then close xemu cleanly.
comparison_questions: In s42-control-board-frame.png, is the entire suspended top-center video board visible, with a full-width base and distinct left and right inset sign regions? Describe only visible geometry and signage.

Comparing s42-control-board-frame.png and s42-wide-overlay8-board-frame.png, does the candidate visibly contain one new continuous wide overlay spanning from the outer left inset corner to the outer right inset corner while the full-width base remains? Is that feature absent from the control?

Are the control and candidate evidence frames sufficiently matched in stadium, teams, play state, replay camera direction, zoom, and board coverage to attribute a board difference to the candidate? List any mismatch or uncertainty.
manual_capture_plan.scope: Use only the three prepared NFL 2K5 xemu configurations on the isolated display, run them sequentially, and keep unrelated Backbreaker artifacts outside the capture workflow.
manual_capture_plan.uncertainty_policy: Record only what is visible in the captured frames and preserve every mismatch or uncertainty.

retail_wide_overlay8.runtime_scope: Boot the exact layout-identical retail-XBE image to the title or main menu and close cleanly. Retail Quick Game does not expose locked s42, so that boot check cannot by itself prove direct board visibility.

s42_control.runtime_scope: Matched retail-geometry control for s42nd.iff using Giants Stadium / Night / Clear.

s42_wide_overlay8.runtime_scope: Exact wide-overlay8 candidate on the same s42nd.iff route and seed state as the control.
